title: RehearsalDebrief
description: After-Action Reflection output contract emitted by tactical-empathy-simulator.

dialogue_openers.description: Observable verbal choices that widened information sharing or lowered conversational friction.

dialogue_closers.description: Observable verbal choices (e.g. premature policy defense, interruption) that narrowed dialogue.

alternative_response.description: One concrete alternative phrasing or tactical question the user could test.

real_world_experiment.description: One small, safe, observable action to take in the upcoming real conversation.

evidence_to_collect.description: Observable real-world signals (e.g. counterpart response time, clarification requests, follow-through).

optional_leadership_development_links.description: Relevant Lumei Leadership Competency areas suggested for ongoing development.

socratic_question.description: EXACTLY ONE Socratic reflection question concluding the debrief.
